📢 We Are Hiring: Content Creator Intern (Fully Remote & Paid) 📢

@aimasukptncom is looking for a motivated Content Creator Intern to join our team. 🎥 This role is ideal for students who closely follow social media trends and want hands-on experience creating content for real projects.

📋 Requirements
✅ Social media enthusiast who stays updated with TikTok and Instagram trends
✅ Confident and comfortable on camera
✅ Skilled in basic video editing
✅ Willing to commit to a 3-month internship program
✅ Not currently undertaking another internship

🎁 What You Will Receive
💰 Daily payment
🏆 Performance bonus
⏰ Flexible working hours (2-4 hours per day)
✈️ International team outing
🌏 Work from anywhere
💼 Hands-on experience with real projects

📝 How to Apply
Submit your application through our Google Form: bit.ly/INTERNAIMASUKPTN 🔗
You may also scan the QR code on the poster. 📲

We look forward to receiving your application. 🤝
